name: lofty_denial
note: wave7 (Rung-1 window, creature-spell filter lane): P0 casts the REAL Staunch Shieldmate (vanilla {W} creature); the WINDOW opens and the Lofty filter (STACK + TYPE_EQ Creature) matches, so P1 — holding the REAL Lofty Denial ({1}{U}) — is asked. P1 answers with its KEY; at resolution the engine builds the {1} kickback plan against P0 (the caster, NOT the counter's controller) and asks pay:<P0>. P0 PAYS: the generic drains its lone R (deterministic), the creature spell LIVES and resolves onto the battlefield. Lofty's colored {U} plus generic {1} drain both seeded blues (same-color-first law). Falsified by flipping the pay answer (zones invert) or by P0 holding nothing to pay (no ask at all). Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
